SIP RFC 4244 / RFC 7044 History-Info (hi-entry) Loop Detection, Privacy Scrubbing & mp= Index Guard
⛔ Vulnerable History-Info Path (Cycles, PII Leak & mp Spoof)
1. A→B→C→A Forwarding Cycle & 70-Hop Header Bloat
• Max-Forwards=70 spins 23 cycles before failure (+11.2 KB header bloat)
• Exhausts B2BUA dialog slots & triggers UDP fragmentation drops
2. Untrusted Egress PII Leak & Ingress VIP Lineage Spoofing
History-Info: <sip:vip-desk@bank.internal>;index=1 (Forged!)
• Egress without Privacy: history leaks internal Pod IPs & extensions
• Ingress spoofed hi-entry tricks AI Bot into VIP auth bypass!
3. Self-Referential / Dangling mp= Tree Parser DoS
<sip:ai-bot@bank.com>;index=1.1;mp=1.1 (Self-Loop / mp=9.9)
• Recursive parent lookup enters infinite loop or throws NullPointer
• Crashes voice gateway worker threads on malformed SIP INVITE
✅ Deterministic RFC 7044 Guardrails (P1011 🎉 + P1012 🎉)
P1011 🎉 (1,020th Guardrail!): Acyclic URI Set & [1, 8] Depth Cap
action: "reject_history_info_forwarding_cycle_with_482_and_cap_depth"
• O(N) canonical hi-targeted-to-uri lookup blocks cycles on hop 1 (482)
• clampedForwardingCycleRedirects = 0 (zero loop amplification)
• clampedMaxHistoryInfoEntries in [1, 8] (converges to fallback AI Bot)
Policy: P1011-SIP-RFC7044-HISTORY-INFO-FORWARDING-LOOP-AND-CHAIN-DEPTH-GUARD
P1012 🎉 (1,030th Probe & 840th POC!): Privacy Scrub & mp= Tree Lock
action: "scrub_untrusted_history_info_and_validate_mp_parent_index"
• Strips untrusted ingress hi-entry & enforces egress Privacy: history
• clampedUnscrubbedInternalTopologyLeaks = 0 (zero internal IP leaks)
• Validates mp=/rc= points to existing strictly-preceding index (dangling = 0)
Policy: P1012-SIP-RFC7044-HISTORY-INFO-UNTRUSTED-PII-SCRUB-AND-MP-INDEX-GUARD
